title: BASIC# Native Parser Dispatch Integration
purpose: Make the bounded independent parser consult the checked-in BASIC#-authored BSBC compiler component for every accepted block-head dispatch decision, with no silent Ruby fallback, while Ruby remains bootstrap and referee authority.
required_proofs: BASIC# native dispatch artifact loads through SmallCompilerSubsetBSBCLoader
SmallCompilerSubsetParser requests its accepted block-head route from the BASIC#-authored BSBC artifact
all nine accepted block heads dispatch to the locked parser decisions
native dispatch invocation count is observable from parser, pipeline, and driver
an invalid or unmatched head is rejected instead of guessed by Ruby
a deliberately wrong native dispatch artifact makes parsing fail visibly instead of falling back to Ruby logic
production Parser construction is unnecessary on the bounded parser primary path
production compiler and Runtime constructors remain unnecessary on the integrated independent primary path
the v0.1.80 bootstrap artifact can compile the v0.1.81 native source, the generated v0.1.81 artifact can compile it again, and both generations are byte-identical
production parser, production BSharp VM, and Ruby Runtime remain separate parity referees
Profiles 1 through 7 and creator-facing syntax remain unchanged
